_about: HAND-AUTHORED SYNTHETIC FIXTURE, not a capture. The config names, entity types and `outputs` maps
are the shapes profiles/genotyping.json carries for the batch chain; the rest is placeholder, and no
value here is a workspace coordinate (`make -s audit`). Shape is what
wrapper is one of the shapes terra/_as_items accepts, so the capture and the live read cannot
disagree about it). It is how scripts/selftest.d/jarshape.sh grades check 2c's DISAGREEMENT arm.
ONE STEP, TWO SUFFIXES. `10-GenotypeBatch` writes `_new` and `10-GenotypeBatch-h2h` -- the name
steps.rerun('10', 'h2h') builds, i.e. the rerun that `--tag h2h` posts -- writes `_h2h`. Every other
numbered config writes `_new`, which is the suffix this arm is run against, so a check that only
asks 'is the in-force suffix among the stored ones' finds `_new` present, calls it agreement, and
prints NOTHING on the one workspace shape that has to be named. Two configs of one step writing two
suffixes means there is no single expected suffix to derive: check 2c prints both with the configs
that write them, picks neither, and refuses the verdict.
